scene: Inside the swaying gondola, soapy suds foam against the glass windows.
beats: You scrape a clean portal through thick suds, revealing spinning storm vanes just as the gondola bumps the rain barrel platform and the doors slide open wide.
The pigeon coos happily, leaves behind an iridescent feather, and swoops out into the breeze right as the cabin docks beside a bubbling cloud tank, doors parting.
Warm rain-scented mist puffs out with a cheerful whistle, billowing through the opening doors to unveil the rainbow-sprinkled rooftops waiting just outside.
picture: Flat side-view inside the enclosed gondola cabin along a metal floor line. On the far left, a cleaner grips a dripping squeegee. Centre, the player in corduroy jacket stands near a pigeon on a rail. On the far right, a shiny red valve is bolted beside the sliding doors.
shown: a long rubber squeegee dripping suds, held on the far left
a fluffy grey pigeon perched calmly on a brass rail centre
a polished red pressure valve mounted to the wall far right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the gondola glides past, swaying gently through drifting drizzle. At the terminus, you hop aboard the rattling mail train, rolling straight into the cavernous, bear-filled Lost Property Depot.
after.then: Step off at Lost Property Depot
